Internal helper that compiles and samples a Stan model

Source: R/fit_embedding.R
dot-fit_embedding_model.Rd

Internal helper that compiles and samples a Stan model

Usage

.fit_embedding_model(
  data,
  family,
  chains = 4,
  iter_warmup = 1000,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Stan data list.

family

Either `"bm"` or `"ou"`.

chains, iter_warmup, iter_sampling

Passed to `$sample()`.

...

Additional arguments passed to `$sample()`.
